title: Bearer credential: one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: one character (!) outside the RFC 6750 b64token alphabet, inside the 16-byte MIN_TOKEN_LEN floor. Twin of "Bearer credential: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
